description: Full detected-pavement training limits; capped task corridor retained as an inspection overlay
legal_position: All four wheel-bottom projections must lie inside the interpolated detected pavement edges and within 2 units of its height; chassis center alone is insufficient.
progress: Maintain a local route-segment cursor and accumulate continuous signed route progress. Intermediate gates are optional guidance and statistics; missed gates do not cap race standing.
start: First forward crossing of the finite start line arms timing. A later forward finish crossing counts a lap when signed unwrapped route travel identifies a full circuit rather than a local recrossing (more than half the route length).
invalid_lap: Crashes end the trajectory. Reversing subtracts route progress; discontinuous cursor jumps add no progress. Intermediate gates are counted once per lap when crossed forward, in any order. Off-road checks affect shaping only.
